agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from rest-energy ~200J hits the arena floor at step 231-232. With no controller work, the contact response should at most reflect velocity with e=0.9 (outgoing <= ~18 m/s) but outgoing vy is +41.47 m/s, more than doubling speed, raising energy to ~862J vs allowed ~225J. The e=0 variant still gains energy (200->279J with outgoing +23.5 m/s from -19.9 m/s), so restitution is not the cause; the floor positional-correction/impulse adds spurious upward velocity on a deep/fast penetrating contact, violating energy_bound.
